title: Research begins, with an AHRC Curiosity Grant
detail: A year to design the research: develop its questions, pilot Endarkened Co-Composition as a methodology, and build the case for what comes next.

title: Research retreat at More Up Campus, Montgomery
detail: Two days of sound-walking near where Anarcha lived, and a speculative storytelling workshop led by Deborah D.E.E.P. Mouton.

title: Archival fieldwork in New York
detail: Time in the collections of the New York Academy of Medicine and the Arthur H. Aufses, Jr. MD Archives at Mount Sinai Hospital in New York City.

title: Intergenerational residency with Professor Evelynn Hammonds
detail: Time in Provincetown with Professor Evelynn Hammonds, historian of science and medicine and a Project Associate, thinking across generations about the archive, absence and listening to history.

title: Listening Across symposium
detail: Clinicians, anthropologists, musicologists and community researchers test whether, when and how Endarkened Co-Composition could work in clinical research.

title: Design phase closes; next stage begins
